name: Boots, Pirate’s
body:
Aura faint abjuration and transmutation; CL 5th; Slot feet; Price 12,500 gp; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

These boots are made of finely tooled leather.

Benefit: The wearer of these boots gains a +5 competence bonus to Acrobatics (jump), Climb, and Swim checks.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, jump, spider climb, endure elements
